def _normalize_level(options: Dict[str, Any], name: str, default: Any) ->Any:
    if name not in options:
        return default
    value = options[name]
    if value is None or value == '':
        return default
    try:
        level = int(value)
        if 1 <= level <= 6:
            return level
        raise ValueError(f'{name} must be between 1 and 6')
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        raise ValueError(f'{name} must be an integer between 1 and 6')
